situation: A wealthy merchant in his study is reviewing a sprawling, meticulously detailed ledger of his own vast gold bullion reserves.

brief: A man in velvet robes sits at a heavy oak desk, his face lit by the warm, reflected yellow glow of floor-to-ceiling stacks of gold bars that crowd the room.
